finalists.label: Viscosupplementation-induced inflammatory synovitis
finalists.why: This candidate has the most specific evidence, including acute bilateral knee swelling and pain, high C-reactive protein level, and high WBC count in the synovial fluid, which are directly related to the viscosupplementation injections.

finalists.label: reactive arthritis
finalists.why: This candidate has some relevant findings, such as onset of pain after the injections, elevated peripheral white blood cell count, and high C-reactive protein and erythrocyte sedimentation rate, but it is less specific to the vignette than Viscosupplementation-induced inflammatory synovitis.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific evidence, including the temporal relationship between the injections and the onset of symptoms, and the high WBC count in the synovial fluid, which is more consistent with a reaction to the viscosupplementation injections.
